item.title: Tech world's calls for Jensen Huang to return to Nvidia are growing
item.description: Calls for Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO are growing, with tech executives and major shareholders backing a potential comeback following his resignation.

item.title: China’s slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates
item.description: A deepening reliance on external demand leaves China more exposed to shocks abroad as domestic momentum fades, analysts say.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO lands as the embattled AI trade looks for a much-needed bright spot
item.description: Anthropic's IPO has outsized importance in the tech industry, which is heavily invested in the AI lab and is desperate for some positive momentum.
